body.p: Chukchi[s]. There lived Chukchi people. They were very small people.[DCh]: "Äuri" for 'Chukchi' is not mentioned in dictionaries; there only "ÄukÄa" (apparently from Russian) occurs. Two Chukchis went, went, went. One deadfall caught those Chukchis.[DCh]: Argument marking is unclear here. One Chukchi was killed by an Evenk. There he took the [other] Chukchi to his own tent (?).[DCh]: Argument marking is unclear here.[DCh]: Argument marking is unclear here. The analysis is One Samoyed came. He saw the Chukchi, he says: "How(?) did you catch the Chukchi?more than tentative. You don't know Chukchis! Kill the Chukchi! They are very bad people!" The Evenk hit the Chukchi with a glaive. The Chukchi dodge and ran off. Then the Samoyed chased [him] [with] three reindeers, he reached the Chukchi. They were fighting, [DCh]: Not clear why fighting, he killed [him].imperative mood here.
